summary: SAIHEAT filed a 6-K containing pro forma financials for its August 10, 2026 reverse merger with Canopy Wave Inc., a Singapore target. Consideration is 3,306,269 SAIHEAT shares, priced at US$18.15, based on Canopy Wave's US$60M pre-money and SAIHEAT's US$40M pre-money valuations. A concurrent PIPE raised roughly US$4.5M from 247,970 Class A shares. Post-close, Canopy Wave holders control about 54.19% economics and 78.44% votes; 110,192 shares sit in a 12-month escrow. The full SAIHEAT board resigns and the company is renamed Canopy Wave Holdings Inc. Watch closing conditions and redemption dynamics.
